title: Find the exact chart-268 feedback minimum and replay all nine releases
body:
## Result

On the funded 0→19 topology, grant chart 421 any XOR of five retained rows and grant chart 0 any XOR of eight preceding arrivals plus its entire 524-dimensional initial stock. Of 8,192 assignments, 2,048 preserve coefficients 17 and 679. The unique least-support residual has nine old coordinates. Its literal word has 63 forward and nine adjoint errors and returns owners 221, 411, and 679 in both orientations. All 636 single-bank overgrants were tested. Only chart 1 can supply the discrepancy, at grade eight.

The same package builds one physical word for each of the nine single-coefficient releases from #8018. All meet their ten-column projected operator. The full forward and adjoint tests still fail, so the nine-coordinate obstruction is inclusion-minimal for this projected roster only. A paid 2234 donor change reduces the particular central feedback residual to e22 and moves failure to other obligations; the full best such control has 70 forward and five adjoint errors and chart 1 rank 536 for 537 targets. The positive nominal funded BIT margin +0.1548121757 at 0.00388 lacks a complete operator. The unchanged rational margin is +0.1389745223.

## Replay

Archive SHA-256 `ca5f5df7a834f9fdcdf73824d356abdf542580f341a23ecac17f6bd071cad0c0`. A fresh extraction passed `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`, checking fourteen literal words in both orientations, exact input rosters, the finite bank search and the 36/48-call arithmetic.

## Prior work and open next questions

#8008 `3c211525087ba8fed1f34e329ff9de095ac133a1` supplies the topology and #8018 `405cbc9f1c457d5cb45a5bcffd883717d0b43bc9` supplies the nine-coordinate obstruction. Using changed endpoints, #8017 `6e090c180ad5c8c9a3ed50e94737fd2be04adf54` reaches native equality and fails paired head geometry. A fixed-endpoint successor must route e22 before the first feedback reader, repair 2677 and the independent chart-1 missing row, and then bind the complete operator, its compiler and erasure, and the finite outer application. No new κ is asserted.
